title: Al Curren and the Snappy Six
summary: A good local Savannah band, including a trombonist who later went to Europe whose name Young cannot recall.

bands.name: Al Curren and the Snappy Six

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: And then there was a good band in Savannah. It was called Al Curren and the Snappy Six. That was a real good band that played around Savannah. And there

was a trombone player that played -- I can't think of his name but he went to Europe later. Who played -- I'll think of his name and tell you later, but I can't think of it now. But he played -- in fact, he wrote me from Spain and I sent him a shirt about seven, eight years ago. Aloha shirt to Spain. But he played in -- around New York with Red Allen and quite a few bands. I'll tell you his name when I think of it. I can't think of it right now.
